sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Rvinyl sells vinyl wraps, window tints, paint protection kits, and craft vinyl products for vehicles.

Industry: Automotive Aftermarket · Size: <$50M · Products: Vinyl Wraps, Window Tints, Paint Protection Kits, Craft Vinyl, Dash Kits, Pillar Trim

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Rvinyl scores 30 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (8/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (40% similar on vinyl, wrap, films, protection); Mactac (34% similar on vinyl, film, print, films); Drytac (18% similar on print, vinyl, film, films). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
